title: Where to get an eye exam, glasses, and contacts in Buenos Aires
useCase: A US-style comprehensive vision check, a reliable glasses prescription and lenses, and a properly fitted supply of daily disposable contacts.
workflowNote: Buenos Aires splits the US optometry workflow. Use an oftalmólogo for the medical exam and prescription, an óptica for glasses, and a contactólogo or contact-lens service for fitting. Bring the written receta to the optical shop.

methodology.summary: Equipment and documented process drive the ranking. Reviews and English are tie-breakers.
methodology.evidenceRule: A generic service claim is not treated as proof of equipment. Confirmed names or explicit workflows score highest; claimed but unnamed equipment scores partially; not publicly documented scores zero.
methodology.perspective: US comprehensive-eye-care expectations, adapted to Argentine professional roles.

sections.title: Ophthalmologists for an exam and prescription
sections.lede: Prioritizes a complete routine exam: subjective refraction, objective measurement, slit-lamp examination, eye pressure, and dilated fundus capability. Surgical lasers do not raise the routine-care score.
sections.equipmentStandard: Best evidence: phoropter or trial-frame refraction; autorefractor/keratometer; slit lamp; tonometry; dilated fundus exam; same-visit written prescription.

entries.name: Hospital Alemán — oftalmología
entries.process: Objective measurement plus trial-frame subjective refraction, pressure and fundus capability. OCT and topography are separate studies when indicated.
entries.bestFor: The strongest public equipment inventory for a US-style routine exam.
entries.caution: Book the Policlínica, not the 24-hour guardia. English is coordinated through the international desk, not guaranteed with every doctor.
entries.coverage: Broad prepaga list including Medifé; verify plan.
entries.english: International desk in English and German
entries.review: Hospital-wide 4.1/5 with high volume; waits are the recurring complaint.

entries.name: Centro Oftalmológico Dr. Andersson
entries.process: The clearest published routine workflow: history, refraction, biomicroscopy, pressure, dilated fundus, diagnosis, prescription and follow-up.
entries.bestFor: A predictable, explicitly documented comprehensive visit.
entries.caution: The site lists advanced imaging separately; do not assume OCT or topography is included.
entries.coverage: OSDE, Swiss Medical, Omint, Galeno and others; private pay.
entries.review: 4.9/5 from 850+ reviews claimed on the official site.

entries.name: Centro Privado de Ojos
entries.process: Walk in for a glasses prescription, then complete objective measurement and the ophthalmologist visit in the same center.
entries.bestFor: Fast walk-in prescription with unusually concrete equipment evidence.
entries.caution: The glasses-Rx lane is for ages 14+. Contact-lens fitting is not documented.
entries.coverage: OSDE, Swiss Medical, Galeno, Medicus, Omint and others.
entries.review: Mixed but useful routine-care reports; urgent-care volume can create queues.

entries.name: Centro de Ojos Liniers
entries.process: Routine exam can hand the prescription directly to the associated Óptica Visual, at a separate nearby address.
entries.bestFor: A west-CABA exam with a practical same-day path to glasses and contacts.
entries.caution: Several device claims are unbranded. The óptica and clinic are separate locations.
entries.coverage: OSDE, SancorSalud and other listed plans.
entries.review: Positive first-party testimonials; independent review volume is less clear.

entries.name: Centro de Ojos Buenos Aires — Manzitti
entries.process: Scheduled consultation includes refraction, anterior segment, pressure and fundus; prescription follows the exam.
entries.bestFor: A complete central-CABA visit with strong corneal imaging.
entries.caution: Demanda espontánea explicitly does not prescribe glasses or contacts. Book a regular appointment.
entries.coverage: Prepagas accepted; verify plan.

entries.name: OCULYX — Dr. Ernesto Rinenberg
entries.process: Long-form evaluation with objective refraction and a broad routine study list.
entries.bestFor: Belgrano patients who want many measurements in one location.
entries.caution: The practice is presbyopia and surgery-forward; the subjective refinement step is not published.
entries.coverage: Selected prepagas and private pay.

entries.name: Hospital Italiano — oftalmología
entries.address: Perón 4272, 5º; optical shop at Perón 4190, CABA
entries.process: Book Atención Primaria Oftalmológica. The electronic prescription can then be used at the hospital optical shop.
entries.bestFor: Hospital-based continuity and a rare on-site optical shop.
entries.caution: The advertised under-10-minute automated vision circuit is in San Justo, outside CABA.
entries.coverage: Hospital plan, many prepagas and private pay.
entries.review: Hospital-wide reviews are dominated by administration rather than eye care.

entries.name: Charles Centro Oftalmológico
entries.process: Book a regular consultorio; objective refraction and imaging are available as listed studies.
entries.bestFor: Broad diagnostic hardware when a routine exam may uncover a complex issue.
entries.caution: The 24-hour guardia will not write a routine glasses prescription.
entries.coverage: Medifé, OSDE, Swiss Medical and many others.

entries.name: Hospital Británico — Microcentro
entries.process: Use the equipment-documented Microcentro center; Perdriel does not publish the same routine kit.
entries.bestFor: A central location with modern objective testing.
entries.caution: The strongest equipment source is the 2023 opening announcement; confirm current availability.
entries.coverage: Hospital plan, obras sociales, prepagas and private pay.
entries.review: Microcentro reviews are mixed on reception and coverage.

entries.name: SOF Buenos Aires
entries.process: Refraction is presented as a separate study rather than a documented complete routine workflow.
entries.bestFor: Corneal and pre-surgical diagnostics near Villa Ortúzar.
entries.caution: Advanced equipment is well documented; routine comprehensive-exam equipment is not.
entries.coverage: Large prepaga and obra social list.

entries.name: Instituto de la Visión
entries.process: Choose Consulta oftalmológica general; the 24-hour guardia does not handle glasses.
entries.bestFor: A routine exam that may need same-site advanced corneal or retinal studies.
entries.caution: The public equipment list is heavily surgical and does not describe a basic exam sequence.
entries.coverage: 40+ listed plans including Medifé.
entries.english: Dr. Badoza speaks English; clinic-wide support unconfirmed

entries.name: Cardimed — oftalmología
entries.address: Av. Presidente Julio A. Roca 620, 3º, CABA
entries.role: MD ophthalmologists in a multispecialty clinic
entries.process: The published visit includes acuity, refraction, pressure, slit lamp and fundus when indicated.
entries.bestFor: A straightforward private-pay Microcentro control.
entries.caution: Limited ophthalmology hours and no named device models.
entries.coverage: Private pay; invoice for reimbursement.

entries.name: Consultorios Oftalmológicos Arenales
entries.process: Online booking is strong, but the routine-equipment evidence is generic.
entries.bestFor: Easy online scheduling in Recoleta.
entries.caution: Most named technology appears on surgery pages, not the routine visit.
entries.coverage: OSDE, Medifé and selected plans.

entries.name: Clínica Oftalmológica Malbrán
entries.process: Traditional appointment-based ophthalmology with very limited public process detail.
entries.bestFor: Established specialist care when a named Malbrán doctor is the priority.
entries.caution: Prestige is not equipment evidence; the current site publishes almost no routine hardware.
entries.coverage: Selected prepagas and private pay.

sections.title: Optical shops for prescription glasses and lenses
sections.lede: Prioritizes accurate as-worn measurements, final lens verification, edging and mounting capability, progressive-lens workflow, adjustment, and remake support.
sections.equipmentStandard: Best evidence: digital centration with the chosen frame; lensometer verification; documented edging or lab workflow; personalized/freeform lens support; final fitting and remake policy.

entries.name: Óptica Pförtner
entries.process: Measure the selected frame digitally, order Essilor/Zeiss/Hoya lenses, edge and mount in-house, verify, then adjust at pickup.
entries.bestFor: The most complete documented measurement-to-mounting workflow in CABA.
entries.caution: Advanced equipment is best documented at Recoleta; expect premium pricing.
entries.coverage: Confirm prepaga or reimbursement at booking.

entries.name: Óptica Ker
entries.process: Two strong digital-measurement systems feed Essilor or HOYA lens orders; the shop claims in-house mounting and QC.
entries.bestFor: Digital progressive-lens measurements in Caballito.
entries.caution: Call to confirm which branch has each measurement system.
entries.coverage: OSDE, Galeno, Sancor and others; plan-specific.

entries.name: Óptica Brillens
entries.address: Marcelo T. de Alvear 770; also Las Heras 1681, CABA
entries.process: Stock single-vision lenses can be mounted in about an hour; multifocals and special treatments use partner labs and include adaptation support.
entries.bestFor: Fast single-vision glasses with strong aftercare.
entries.caution: The one-hour promise is stock-dependent; multifocals take longer.
entries.coverage: Broad discount and coverage network; verify whether it is a formal convenio.
entries.english: English reviews exist; service not guaranteed
entries.review: Near-perfect aggregate with high volume, especially for speed and aftercare.

entries.name: Laboratorio Óptico Foucault
entries.process: Bring an ophthalmologist prescription; the specialty lab emphasizes precision multifocals, high prescriptions and low-vision work.
entries.bestFor: Complex prescriptions and specialty optical work.
entries.caution: Its contact-lens equipment is much better documented than its glasses-lab hardware.
entries.coverage: Private specialty lab; no published plan list.

entries.name: Ópticas Montenero — Recoleta
entries.process: Digital measurement and external Essilor/HOYA/Zeiss/Vitolen lab workflow.
entries.bestFor: A Recoleta shop combining progressive-lens measurement with contactology.
entries.caution: The equipment page is marketing-level and does not assign devices to a branch.
entries.coverage: Claims all obras sociales and prepagas; verify.

entries.name: Óptica Visual Liniers
entries.role: Retail optical shop partnered with Centro de Ojos Liniers

claimed: Monocular PD, height, vertex and frame-angle measurements

entries.process: Measure in store, send to external labs, verify finished lenses with a frontofocómetro, fit at pickup.
entries.bestFor: A transparent external-lab workflow and easy transfer from Centro de Ojos Liniers.
entries.caution: No in-house lens fabrication; progressives take about 5–10 business days.
entries.coverage: Ask about reimbursement and current discounts.

entries.name: Óptica Augusto — Parque Patricios
entries.process: The Caseros branch claims its own digital lab; stronger Visioffice and express claims belong to the separate La Rioja branch.
entries.bestFor: A south-CABA local shop with claimed in-house digital work.
entries.caution: Graduated glasses are listed as non-returnable and the remake workflow is not published.
entries.coverage: No reliable public plan list.

entries.name: Cerdán Óptica Avanzada
entries.process: Prescription-first specialty optical work with freeform and high-prescription emphasis.
entries.bestFor: High prescriptions, low vision or a contactology-led optical consult.
entries.caution: The advanced positioning is credible, but named hardware is almost entirely absent.
entries.coverage: Payment plans and some PAMI work; verify.

sections.title: Contact-lens fitting and daily disposables
sections.lede: Prioritizes corneal measurement, slit-lamp assessment, trial lenses, daily-disposable stock, insertion/removal teaching, and follow-up—not merely selling sealed boxes.
sections.equipmentStandard: Best evidence: topography or keratometry; slit lamp; ocular-surface or tear assessment; trial inventory; daily-disposable brands; teaching and follow-up.

entries.name: Laboratorio Óptico Foucault

confirmed: Custom soft, RGP and scleral manufacture

entries.process: Topography and video slit-lamp evaluation, trial or custom design, teaching, and documented follow-up in specialist fitting rooms.
entries.bestFor: The strongest documented clinical contactology setup, from ordinary dailies to complex corneas.
entries.caution: Requires an ophthalmologist prescription and appointment; no Saturday hours.
entries.coverage: Private specialty service; no public plan list.
entries.review: Google 4.8/5 from about 280 reviews, with strong fitting comments.

entries.name: Óptica Pförtner
entries.process: Prescription, individual evaluation, trial and adjustment, teaching, periodic controls, then online reordering for established wearers.
entries.bestFor: Daily disposables with strong stock and a mature fitting/manufacturing operation.
entries.caution: Advanced contactology is best documented at Recoleta; bring a current ophthalmologist prescription.
entries.coverage: Confirm at booking.

entries.name: Centro de Ojos Liniers + Óptica Visual
entries.process: Medical exam and corneal studies at the clinic, then fitting/product work at the associated optical shop.
entries.bestFor: A medically supervised contact pathway in west CABA.
entries.caution: The two locations and websites blur which step happens where; confirm before booking.
entries.coverage: Selected prepagas at the clinic; óptica benefits vary.
entries.review: Positive but limited contact-specific independent evidence.

entries.name: Ópticas Montenero — Recoleta
entries.process: Free soft-lens trial with visual-acuity and rotation checks, teaching, then follow-up; specialty scleral trial is paid.
entries.bestFor: A well-documented first-time soft-lens trial in central CABA.
entries.caution: The fit process is strong, but key corneal and ocular-surface devices are not published.
entries.coverage: Claims broad plan acceptance; verify.

entries.name: Cerdán Óptica Avanzada
entries.process: Prescription-first specialty adaptation with pre-consultation by WhatsApp.
entries.bestFor: Complex or scleral-lens questions in Caballito.
entries.caution: The specialty positioning is strong; the public equipment evidence is weak.
entries.coverage: Verify directly.

entries.name: Óptica Brillens
entries.address: Marcelo T. de Alvear 770; also Las Heras 1681, CABA
entries.process: Retail selection and adaptation advice; no equipment-backed fitting protocol is published.
entries.bestFor: Convenient replenishment after an established prescription.
entries.caution: Not the first choice for a new fit under a US clinical standard.
entries.coverage: Broad discounts and plan network.

entries.name: Óptica Visual Liniers
entries.role: Optical shop partnered with an ophthalmology clinic
entries.process: Bring a contact-lens-specific prescription, choose from stocked brands, then receive basic handling instruction.
entries.bestFor: Buying known dailies after a medical fitting.
entries.caution: Complex fitting equipment is at Centro de Ojos Liniers, not this optical shop.
entries.coverage: Ask about current discounts.

entries.name: Óptica Ker
entries.process: Retail and claimed individual evaluation, with no published clinical fitting sequence.
entries.bestFor: Convenient Caballito purchase after a prescription is already established.
entries.caution: Its glasses measurement technology is excellent; contact-fitting evidence is not.
entries.coverage: Plan-specific discounts.

excluded.name: Óptica Lombardi
excluded.reason: No CABA branch; all verified locations are in GBA.

excluded.name: Óptica Elena
excluded.reason: Official locations are in Santa Fe and Córdoba, not CABA.

excluded.name: Óptica Marialuz
excluded.reason: Official locations are in Mar del Plata; CABA listings conflate another business.
